parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `Desc`: descending order

- `Asc`: ascending order

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. The [CreateResource](~~412111~~) operation returns this ID.

parameters.name: ResourceName
parameters.description: The resource group name. The [CreateResource](~~412111~~) operation returns this name.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource group type. Valid values:

- `Dedicated`: dedicated resource group

- `SelfManaged`: self-managed resource group

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The sort field. Timestamp fields are sorted in descending order by default.

parameters.name: UsageMode
parameters.description: The usage mode of the resource group. The default value is `inference`.
